text: The key difference between CCHM and Cartesian cubical type theory is:
choices: CCHM uses univalence as an axiom; Cartesian does not
CCHM has a De Morgan algebra on I (with ~, ∧, ∨); Cartesian uses only the product structure
Cartesian cubical TT has canonicity; CCHM does not
They are equivalent in all respects
explanation: CCHM has complement ~, giving definitional reversal. Cartesian cubical TT is simpler (no ~) but loses definitional reversal.
